cases.sentence: Никто не должен входить в собрание Господа, кроме как ___ со здоровой плотью.
cases.translation: No one may enter the Lord's assembly except a man with whole flesh.
cases.explain: A noun in the nominative case serves as the subject of this statement.

cases.sentence: Никто из незаконнорожденных не должны входить в собрание Господа и его ___ до десятого поколения.
cases.translation: No illegitimate person or his descendants may enter the Lord's assembly to the tenth generation.
cases.explain: With the preposition и, the genitive case is used for the descendants.

cases.sentence: Аммонитянин и Моавитянин не должны входить в собрание Господа, они и их ___ до десятого поколения.
cases.translation: An Ammonite or Moabite may not enter the Lord's assembly, nor may his descendants to the tenth generation.
cases.explain: The subject of a statement takes nominative case.

cases.sentence: Потому что они не пришли с хлебом и ___ встречать вас на дороге из Египта.
cases.translation: Because they did not come to meet you with bread and water on the way out of Egypt.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Эдомитянин — твой брат, поэтому не гнушайся ___.
cases.translation: An Edomite is your brother, therefore do not despise him.
cases.explain: The verb гнушайся (despise) takes the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Египтянин — твой сосед, не враждуй с ___.
cases.translation: An Egyptian is your neighbor, do not be hostile to him.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) takes the instrumental case to indicate association.

cases.sentence: Если мужчина скажет обет Господу или поклянется ___.
cases.translation: If a man makes a vow to the Lord or swears an oath.
cases.explain: The verb поклянется (will swear) requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Он не должен нарушить свой ___, но должен исполнить все, что вышло из его уст.
cases.translation: He must not break his vow but must fulfill all that comes out of his mouth.
cases.explain: The verb нарушить (to break) requires the accusative case for its direct object.

reading.ru: Никто не должен входить в собрание Господа, у кого оскоплен половой орган.
reading.question: Who is excluded from entering the Lord's assembly according to this law?
options: Anyone whose genitals have been castrated
reading.correct: Anyone whose genitals have been castrated
reading.explain: The text states: 'у кого оскоплен половой орган' (whose genitals have been castrated).

reading.ru: Никто из незаконнорожденных и его потомков не должны входить в собрание Господа.
reading.question: What status is affected by the prohibition on illegitimate births?
options: Illegitimate persons and all their descendants
Only those born out of wedlock
reading.correct: Illegitimate persons and all their descendants
reading.explain: The text says: 'Никто из незаконнорожденных и его потомков' (no illegitimate person and his descendants).

reading.ru: Аммонитянин и Моавитянин не должны входить в собрание Господа, они и их потомки до десятого поколения.
reading.question: For how many generations are Ammonites and Moabites excluded from the Lord's assembly?
reading.explain: The law specifies: 'до десятого поколения' (to the tenth generation).

reading.ru: Потому что они не пришли с хлебом и водой встречать вас на дороге из Египта.
reading.question: Why are Ammonites and Moabites excluded from the assembly?
options: Because they did not meet you with bread and water on the way out of Egypt
Because they refused to serve Israel
Because they were enemies in battle
reading.correct: Because they did not meet you with bread and water on the way out of Egypt
reading.explain: The reason given is: 'потому что они не пришли с хлебом и водой встречать вас' (because they did not come with bread and water to meet you).

reading.ru: Эдомитянин — твой брат, поэтому не гнушайся им.
reading.question: What is your relationship to an Edomite, and how should you treat them?
options: An Edomite is your brother, so do not despise him
An Edomite is your enemy, so avoid them
An Edomite is a stranger, so be cautious
An Edomite is a servant, so command them
reading.correct: An Edomite is your brother, so do not despise him
reading.explain: The instruction is: 'Эдомитянин — твой брат, поэтому не гнушайся им' (An Edomite is your brother, therefore do not despise him).

reading.ru: Если мужчина скажет обет Господу или поклянется клятву, то он не должен нарушить свою слово.
reading.question: What obligation does a man have if he makes a vow or oath to the Lord?
options: He must not break his word and must fulfill all he has promised
He can change his mind later
He needs permission from the priest
He should ask his wife's approval
reading.correct: He must not break his word and must fulfill all he has promised
reading.explain: The law states: 'он не должен нарушить свою слово' (he must not break his word).
